---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new tool or a change to an existing one
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the use case — what would you be able to do with an AI agent that
you can't do today?

## Proposed tool(s) or change

If you're proposing a new tool, name it and describe its inputs/outputs at a
high level. If you're proposing a change to an existing tool, describe the
current behavior and what should change.

## OctoBot route(s) involved, if known

If you know which OctoBot HTTP route(s) this would map to (e.g. from
OctoBot's own web UI or API docs), name them here — this project verifies
every route against
[OctoBot's source](https://github.com/Drakkar-Software/OctoBot) before
implementing rather than guessing, so a starting pointer helps
(see `CONTRIBUTING.md`). If you don't know, that's fine — just say so.

## Is this destructive or high-risk?

Would this action delete data, write exchange credentials, or enable live
trading? This project confirm-gates that category of tool (ADR-0003) — say
if you think this would need it.

## Alternatives considered

Any workaround you're currently using, or other approaches you considered.
